It started with a dog. The rest is still being written.

01

01 — Meet Smitter B.

Bodhi, better known as Smitter B, has a pretty simple approach to life. A walk, some fresh air, and his favorite people are all it takes to make his day.

Watching him find so much happiness in the little things got us thinking. Maybe he's onto something.

Chapter 01 01
“

Watching him find so much happiness in the little things got us thinking. Maybe he's onto something.

— Bodhi “Smitter B”
02

02 — The good days are happening right now.

We spend a lot of time looking forward to what's next, and not enough appreciating what's right in front of us.

The long afternoons, spontaneous plans, and time with the people we love. Those are the moments we wanted Golden Days to celebrate.

Chapter 02 02
“

The long afternoons, spontaneous plans, and time with the people we love. Those are the moments we wanted Golden Days to celebrate.

— The Good Days Are Right Now
03

03 — So we made something simple.

We wanted a drink that matched that easygoing spirit. Something refreshing, without the bubbles, excessive sweetness, or unnecessary extras.

So we created Golden Days. Real vodka, real fruit juice, no carbonation, and no added sugar.

Simple by design. Easy to enjoy.

Chapter 03 03
“

Real vodka, real fruit juice, no carbonation, and no added sugar. Simple by design. Easy to enjoy.

— Simple By Design
04

04 — Then came the hard part.

Turns out, starting a beverage company is a little more complicated than we expected.

From developing flavors and designing cans to getting Golden Days onto shelves, we've been figuring things out as we go.

It's been a lot of work, a lot of learning, and a lot of fun.

Chapter 04 04
“

From developing flavors and designing cans to getting Golden Days onto shelves, we've been figuring things out as we go.

— Building Golden Days
05

05 — This is just the beginning.

What started with a dog and a simple idea is becoming something much bigger.

We're building Golden Days one store, one event, and one new connection at a time.

And if there's one thing Smitter B has taught us, it's that you don't have to wait for the good days. You're already living them.

Chapter 05 05
“

You don't have to wait for the good days. You're already living them.

— This Is Just The Beginning
